name: kairos-ai
description: An AI-powered, GROQ-accelerated Socratic tutor for DSA, competitive programming, and system design.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend/types --if-present && npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend/types && npm run typecheck --workspace api && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api && npm run test --workspace frontend
